heading: Northern health.
A shared view of the evidence.
lead: Explore the communities, health services and research capacity that shape Northern British Columbia.
body: The NHHR Atlas brings collected research evidence together through stories, maps and data. Start with a question, follow a story, or look closely at the records behind it.

context.heading: Understanding the North starts with context.
context.body: This release covers {topics}. Each view keeps its source, period and geographic scope in sight.

stories.title: Research stories
stories.description: Follow guided maps and short stories connecting communities, health services and research across Northern BC.

explore.title: Data explorer
explore.description: Browse and download the source records behind the stories.

sources.title: Sources and methods
sources.description: Understand where the evidence comes from, how the geography connects and what each measure can tell you.

note: An independent research interface for the NHHR feasibility work. Source periods and coverage vary; projections and hypothetical scenarios are labelled in each view.
